purpose: Bounded field qualification of the public v4-to-v5 application-repository upgrade path.

isolation.method: detached disposable Git worktree at the adopter source commit
isolation.reason: Exercise real tracked adopter bytes without modifying its primary checkout.
isolation.cleanup: The worktree and all candidate-only changes were removed after observation.
isolation.source_checkout_after_cleanup: clean at the original source commit

applied_changes: update the unchanged Claude Code native skill
update the unchanged Codex native skill
host_integration.preservation: Everything outside managed blocks and unchanged integration-owned skill files remained project-owned.

project_gate.expected_reason: The structural migrator deliberately does not invent v5 semantic documentation or refresh content-bound review.

steps.name: discipline-checks
steps.observation: 240 findings over 29 Python files, including the deliberately stale review and newly required local-binding and narration obligations.

steps.name: import-contracts
steps.observation: Four contracts kept and none broken.

steps.name: documentation
steps.observation: The preserved project Doxyfile generated 20 source pages without warnings.

steps.name: mutation
steps.observation: All 137 mutants across one domain path were killed.

steps.name: artifact-build
steps.observation: The wheel and sdist for sumtwo 1.0.0 were built and inspected.

steps.name: clean-install
steps.observation: The wheel installed into a clean environment; one import and four entry-point probes passed.

conclusion: The v5 package upgrades and integrates a real v4 application without guessing project prose or weakening unrelated evidence. It then fails closed on exactly the project-authored documentation and content-review work the migration says remains. This is field evidence for migration behavior, not v5 certification of the adopter application.
scope_limit: No adopter source was edited for compliance, no adopter commit was created, and no repository other than python-doctrine-test was opened or executed for this field qualification.
